text_en: Afterward Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said, “Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel, ‘Let my people go, so that they may celebrate a festival to me in the wilderness. ’”
text_cn: 此后，梅瑟同亚郎去见法郎说：“以色列的天主雅威这样说：“你应放我的百姓走，好叫他们在旷野里过节敬拜我。”

text_en: But Pharaoh said, “Who is the Lord , that I should heed him and let Israel go? I do not know the Lord , and I will not let Israel go. ”
text_cn: 法郎问说：“谁是雅威，我该听他的命，放以色列走？我不认识雅威，也不放以色列走。”

text_en: Then they said, “The God of the Hebrews has revealed himself to us; let us go a three days’ journey into the wilderness to sacrifice to the Lord our God, or he will fall upon us with pestilence or sword. ”
text_cn: 他们回答说：“希伯来人的天主遇见了我们。请让我们走三天的路到旷野里，向上主我们的天主献祭，免得他用瘟疫刀兵击杀我们。”

text_en: But the king of Egypt said to them, “Moses and Aaron, why are you taking the people away from their work? Get to your labors! ”
text_cn: 埃及王回答他们说：“梅瑟、亚郎啊！你们为什么妨碍百姓工作呢？去服你们的劳役罢！”

text_en: Pharaoh continued, “Now they are more numerous than the people of the land and yet you want them to stop working! ”
text_cn: 法郎又说：“现在他们比本地的人民还多，你们竟然叫他们歇工？”

text_en: That same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people, as well as their supervisors,
text_cn: 那一天法郎命令那些百姓中的监工和工头说：“

text_en: “You shall no longer give the people straw to make bricks, as before; let them go and gather straw for themselves.
text_cn: 你们以后不要再像往日一样，给百姓做砖用的草秸，叫他们自己去拾草。

text_en: But you shall require of them the same quantity of bricks as they have made previously; do not diminish it, for they are lazy; that is why they cry, ‘Let us go and offer sacrifice to our God. ’
text_cn: 但你们仍向他们要往日所做的同样砖数，一点也不可减少，因为他们懒惰，所以才呐喊说：我们要去向我们的天主献祭。

text_en: Let heavier work be laid on them; then they will labor at it and pay no attention to deceptive words. ”
text_cn: 应给这些人加重工作，使他们只工作，而不听谎言。”

text_en: So the taskmasters and the supervisors of the people went out and said to the people, “Thus says Pharaoh, ‘I will not give you straw.
text_cn: 百姓中的监工头遂出去向百姓说：“法郎这样吩咐：我再不给你们草秸。

text_en: Go and get straw yourselves, wherever you can find it; but your work will not be lessened in the least. ’”
text_cn: 你们看哪里能找到草秸，就到那里去拾吧！但应有的工作一点也不可减少。”

text_en: So the people scattered throughout the land of Egypt, to gather stubble for straw.
text_cn: 百姓就分散到埃及全境，拾取麦茎充当草秸。

text_en: The taskmasters were urgent, saying, “Complete your work, the same daily assignment as when you were given straw. ”
text_cn: 监工催迫说：“你们每天应该完成当天的工作，像从前有草秸时一样。”

text_en: And the supervisors of the Israelites, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and were asked, “Why did you not finish the required quantity of bricks yesterday and today, as you did before? ”
text_cn: 法郎的监工责打他们所派出的以色列子民的工头说：“你们昨天今天为什么没有完成像前天所做的砖数呢？”

text_en: Then the Israelite supervisors came to Pharaoh and cried, “Why do you treat your servants like this?
text_cn: 以色列子民的工头遂去向法郎诉苦说：“你为什么这样对待你的仆人们呢？

text_en: No straw is given to your servants, yet they say to us, ‘Make bricks! ’ Look how your servants are beaten! You are unjust to your own people. ”
text_cn: 不给你仆人们草秸，只对我们说：做砖吧！原是你人民的错，你却来打你的仆人们。”

text_en: He said, “You are lazy, lazy; that is why you say, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to the Lord . ’
text_cn: 法郎回答说：“你们太懒惰了！所以说：让我们去祭献上主！

text_en: Go now, and work; for no straw shall be given you, but you shall still deliver the same number of bricks. ”
text_cn: 现在都快去作工！决不供给你们草秸，但是砖却该如数交上。”

text_en: The Israelite supervisors saw that they were in trouble when they were told, “You shall not lessen your daily number of bricks. ”
text_cn: 以色列子民的工头因所出的命令说：“你们每天应做的砖数，不得减少，”便知自己更陷于困难中。

text_en: As they left Pharaoh, they came upon Moses and Aaron who were waiting to meet them.
text_cn: 工头们由法郎那里出来，遇见梅瑟和亚郎正等候他们，

text_en: They said to them, “The Lord look upon you and judge! You have brought us into bad odor with Pharaoh and his officials, and have put a sword in their hand to kill us. ”
text_cn: 就对他们说：“愿上主鉴察惩罚你们！你们使我们在法郎和他臣仆眼中成了可恨的，就好像把刀交在他们手中，宰杀我们。”

text_en: Then Moses turned again to the Lord and said, “O Lord , why have you mistreated this people? Why did you ever send me?
text_cn: 梅瑟回到上主那里说：“吾主，你为什么折磨这百姓？为什么偏偏打发我呢？

text_en: Since I first came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has mistreated this people, and you have done nothing at all to deliver your people. ”
text_cn: 自从我到法郎那里，奉你的名讲话以来，他更加折磨这百姓，而你也没有拯救你的百姓。”
